name: AirAsia Group Berhad
overview: 2026年公司由 AirAsia X Berhad 更名为 AirAsia Group Berhad，并持续推进涉及 AAAGL 与 AAB 的收购提案及相关企业行动。公司业务线涵盖长程航空运输、商业航空运输、物流管理及飞机设施租赁，但公告中未披露各板块的具体运营变化。
overview_en: In 2026, the company changed its name from AirAsia X Berhad to AirAsia Group Berhad and continued to pursue acquisition proposals involving AAAGL and AAB along with related corporate actions. Its business lines cover long-haul air transportation, commercial air transport, logistical management and marketing services, and aircraft facility leasing, but the announcements do not disclose specific operational changes by segment.

actions.title: Change of Company Name - AIRASIA GROUP BERHAD
actions.text: 公司名称由 AirAsia X Berhad 更改为 AirAsia Group Berhad。
